name: Backend Required Quality Gates

on:
  pull_request:

      - main
      - dev
  push:

      - main

permissions:

concurrency:
  group: backend-required-${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}

  path-classification:

    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

      backend: ${{ steps.classify.outputs.backend }}
